title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 6: C1 PROFESSIONAL & GLOBAL COMMUNICATION
description: A high-level communication world focused on professional judgment, leadership, collaboration, global communication, and precise English in demanding real-world situations.

targets.vocabulary: 3700+ active words and high-frequency professional collocations
targets.reading: 2000–2600 words with synthesis, evaluation, and implied meaning
targets.listening: 20–26 minutes across meetings, interviews, presentations, and authentic discussions
targets.speaking: 25–32 minutes of sustained professional and collaborative communication
targets.writing: 750–950 words across reports, proposals, recommendations, and reflective analysis
targets.presentation: 12–16 minutes with structured delivery and live Q&A
targets.professionalCommunication: confident C1 communication across formal, collaborative, and international contexts

grammar: advanced tense and aspect choices for precise sequencing and stance
modal verbs and modal perfects for probability, obligation, criticism, and deduction
complex conditionals and mixed hypothetical structures
advanced passive, reporting, and impersonal constructions
participial clauses, reduced clauses, and dense noun phrases
inversion, fronting, clefting, and information-structure choices
advanced relative clauses, apposition, and nominalization
ellipsis, substitution, parallelism, and discourse cohesion
concession, qualification, hedging, boosting, and diplomatic language
register shifting between conversational, professional, academic, and executive English

missions.title: Professional Vocabulary Command
missions.focus: High-precision professional vocabulary, collocations, and lexical choice
missions.outcome: Select natural C1 vocabulary for workplace, project, and leadership contexts.

missions.title: Decision-Making Language Lab
missions.focus: Expressing options, trade-offs, evidence, risk, and recommendations
missions.outcome: Explain and justify decisions with precise, balanced language.

missions.title: Leadership Communication Arena
missions.focus: Delegation, alignment, feedback, accountability, and motivation
missions.outcome: Lead short professional interactions while maintaining clarity and diplomacy.

missions.title: Diplomatic Disagreement Mission
missions.focus: Polite disagreement, qualification, challenge, and face-saving strategies
missions.outcome: Disagree constructively without sounding abrupt, vague, or overly indirect.

missions.title: Problem-Solving Command Center
missions.focus: Diagnosing causes, proposing solutions, prioritizing actions, and evaluating outcomes
missions.outcome: Handle complex problems through structured spoken and written English.

missions.title: Meeting Intelligence Lab
missions.focus: Interrupting appropriately, clarifying, summarizing, redirecting, and closing
missions.outcome: Participate actively and naturally in fast-moving professional meetings.

missions.title: Negotiation Strategy Arena
missions.focus: Persuasion, concessions, conditions, priorities, and mutually acceptable outcomes
missions.outcome: Negotiate with nuanced language while protecting goals and relationships.

missions.title: Conflict Mediation Mission
missions.focus: Reframing conflict, acknowledging concerns, and building workable agreements
missions.outcome: Use diplomatic English to move difficult conversations toward resolution.

missions.title: Cross-Cultural Communication Lab
missions.focus: Directness, politeness, expectations, ambiguity, and international communication norms
missions.outcome: Adapt communication choices for culturally diverse professional settings.

missions.title: Executive Conversation Arena
missions.focus: Spontaneous discussion, follow-up questions, nuance, and concise answers
missions.outcome: Respond confidently to challenging questions without losing precision.

missions.title: Global Reading Intelligence
missions.focus: Reports, policy-style texts, business analysis, and competing viewpoints
missions.outcome: Identify claims, assumptions, implications, and evidence across complex texts.

missions.title: Authentic Workplace Listening
missions.focus: Meetings, interviews, presentations, and spontaneous professional speech
missions.outcome: Track key ideas, implied meaning, stance, and changing priorities in real time.

missions.title: Strategic Report Writing
missions.focus: Executive summaries, findings, recommendations, and evidence-based structure
missions.outcome: Write concise, coherent reports that support practical decisions.

missions.title: Proposal & Recommendation Lab
missions.focus: Persuasive proposals, options analysis, benefits, risks, and implementation
missions.outcome: Produce professional recommendations with clear reasoning and appropriate register.

missions.title: Presentation Command Center
missions.focus: Signposting, emphasis, visual explanation, transitions, and live Q&A
missions.outcome: Deliver a structured C1 presentation and handle unexpected questions.

missions.title: Crisis Communication Simulation
missions.focus: Urgency, uncertainty, accountability, reassurance, and action planning
missions.outcome: Communicate clearly and responsibly when information is incomplete or changing.

missions.title: Technology, Work & Society
missions.focus: Digital transformation, AI, changing workplaces, ethics, and social impact
missions.outcome: Discuss complex technology and society topics using evidence and nuanced stance.

missions.title: Global Collaboration Simulation
missions.focus: International project planning, role coordination, deadlines, and compromise
missions.outcome: Collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders in a realistic global scenario.

missions.title: World 6 Integrated Professional Marathon
missions.focus: Integrated vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, and writing
missions.outcome: Demonstrate sustained C1 performance across a multi-stage professional challenge.

missions.title: WORLD 6 MASTER QUEST — C1 PROFESSIONAL & GLOBAL COMMUNICATION
missions.focus: Final integrated leadership, negotiation, presentation, and communication challenge
missions.outcome: Complete a full C1 professional communication mission with adaptive language, strategic reasoning, and confident delivery.

realWorldScenarios: Leading a project kickoff meeting with international teammates
Negotiating priorities and deadlines with a project partner
Giving constructive feedback to a teammate
Handling a disagreement between two stakeholders
Presenting a recommendation to a decision-making group
Responding to unexpected questions during a presentation
Writing an executive summary after reviewing complex information
Managing a communication problem during a fast-changing situation
Participating in a cross-cultural workplace discussion
Planning a collaborative project with distributed international teams

assessment.successCriteria: Learner communicates clearly, flexibly, and precisely in demanding professional and global contexts, adapting register, structure, tone, and language to audience and purpose.
